blocks.h: Send documents for a free check
What we check before you pay anything
bullets: Approval status of the layout — DTCP or PPA, and whether the approval is current
Patta and chitta in the seller's name, matching the survey number
Encumbrance certificate for the last 15 to 30 years
Parent documents and the chain of ownership
Any court attachment, bank mortgage or pending dues on the property
Actual measurements on site against what the document says

paras: We charge the buyer a service fee of 2% of the property value up to ₹1 crore, and 1% above ₹1 crore. It is payable after registration, not before. There is no fee for searching, visiting or document checking.
Not sure what a property should cost? [Ask for a free valuation](/free-property-valuation) of anything you are considering.

items.q: What is the difference between DTCP and PPA approval?
items.a: DTCP is the Tamil Nadu Directorate of Town and Country Planning; PPA is the Puducherry Planning Authority. Which one applies depends on which side of the border the land sits, and it affects loans and resale. We confirm the approving authority and the approval number for every property we handle.

items.q: Will a bank give a loan on the property?
items.a: Approved layouts with a clean chain of documents are usually financeable. We tell you upfront where a bank is likely to refuse, and we work with buyers' banks through the process.

Yes, NRIs and persons of Indian origin can buy residential and commercial property in India. Agricultural land, plantations and farmhouses cannot be purchased, only inherited. We can handle the entire purchase under a power of attorney if you cannot travel.
Once the documents are clean and the price is agreed, registration is usually completed within two to three weeks.
